risk_summary: The disclosure is reasonably quantified regarding reimbursement rates, contracts, debt, and purchase commitments, but relies on forward-looking assurances and contains incomplete context from omitted tables and truncated text. Key risks include contract expirations, depressed PBRT volumes, COVID-19 and supply-chain effects, refinancing and interest-rate uncertainty, and substantial unfunded equipment commitments.
